walkAttempts.prompt:
Create exactly EIGHT complete character drawings, a four-frame WALK CYCLE in two directions, 4 columns by 2 rows. These are NEW walking poses of Fabius NORMAL REQUIEM from the complete references. Reference1 supplies the existing correct leg opposition. Reference2 fixes identity/anatomy/age/costume. Reference3 supplies the exact SW and W body orientations to use (middle and bottom rows). Keep the approved same ADULT-STYLIZED proportions and body size, no smaller younger/chibi redesign and no growth of hair. Dark brown natural canonical short layered haircut, dark RED eyes, clean warm skin, black long coat with restrained burgundy lining, small physical red seam/stud accents only, black pants/gloves/boots and neutral SILVER katana in anatomical RIGHT hand. No transformation color, crystals, aura or red blade.
ROW1 = SOUTHWEST WALK: clear down-left diagonal front-threequarter, exactly the orientation of middle row in reference3. ROW2 = WEST WALK: true LEFT PROFILE, nose/toes point left, one visible eye, exactly bottom row in reference3. Draw actual directions, never mirrors.
NEW GAIT STRATEGY: the camera sees the character's LEFT SIDE for both directions. The NEAR leg is anatomical LEFT, and the FAR leg is anatomical RIGHT. The near LEFT arm is EMPTY; the far RIGHT hand holds the sword low. Keep those sides consistent.
COLUMN1: NEAR LEFT leg slopes FORWARD toward screen-left from the near hip; near left boot is the LEFTMOST boot. FAR RIGHT leg slopes BACK toward screen-right, right boot is the RIGHTMOST boot. Both knees nearly extended in walking contact.
COLUMN2: NEAR LEFT leg supports vertically under near hip. FAR RIGHT knee lifts and crosses forward, far right boot off ground. The visible near boot remains grounded.
COLUMN3: REVERSE THE STRIDE, visibly and anatomically. NEAR LEFT thigh slopes BACK toward screen-right from the near hip; its boot is the RIGHTMOST boot, BEHIND the pelvis. FAR RIGHT thigh slopes FORWARD screen-left; far right boot is the LEFTMOST boot, AHEAD of pelvis. Show the NEAR LEFT leg CONTINUOUSLY from near hip to the BACK boot, overlapping the far leg correctly. Column3 MUST NOT repeat the same forward thigh as column1.
COLUMN4: FAR RIGHT leg supports vertically. NEAR LEFT knee lifts and crosses forward; near left boot off ground, far right boot grounded. The opposite support of column2.
Walking, not running: steady upright torso, small pelvis bob, counter-swing empty LEFT arm, controlled right-hand sword and gentle coat motion. Keep the NEAR thigh unobstructed enough to read its forward/back exchange. Preserve complete head/body/arms/hands/boots AND whole sword tip, generous transparent spacing around each whole figure, no overlap or cutoff. Actually transparent RGBA background, crisp deliberate pixel-cluster raster consistent with references. No text, grid, captions, ground, shadow, haze, gradient, checkerboard, blur, anatomical assembly, body-part transplantation, flat rotations, warps or mirrored views.

Draw a genuine FOUR-POSE walking cycle using the TWO OPPOSITE CONTACT POSES in reference1. Exactly EIGHT COMPLETE Fabius Normal Requiem sprites, 4 columns x 2 rows. The reference1 TOP LEFT figure and TOP CENTER figure have OPPOSITE legs forward: use BOTH as walking pose authorities, not just top-left. Reference2 is the approved same Fabius identity, body proportions, costume and neutral silver katana.
ROW1 faces clear SOUTHWEST down-left 45 degrees (NOT FRONT VIEW): head, sternum, hips and feet all point down-left. ROW2 faces true WEST left profile with ONE visible eye (not threequarter).
COLUMN1 is the leg-contact pose corresponding to reference1 TOP LEFT, redrawn in the new direction.
COLUMN2 is the passing pose AFTER that contact, with the previously rear leg passing forward and the other leg supporting.
COLUMN3 is the OPPOSITE CONTACT pose corresponding to reference1 TOP CENTER, redrawn in the new direction. This column MUST switch which THIGH is forward, not merely slightly bend the same knees. Make the visible near LEFT thigh extend BEHIND the body toward screen-RIGHT, its near boot the RIGHTMOST boot, while the far RIGHT leg and far boot extend AHEAD toward screen-LEFT. Show a clean continuous near LEFT thigh-to-shin-to-boot diagonal sloping BACKWARD toward RIGHT, crossing over the far leg correctly. Do not show the near thigh extending left/forward in column3. Keep cloth aside so hips and both knees are readable. This reversed pose is the MOST IMPORTANT requirement.
COLUMN4 is the opposite passing pose, the other support leg grounded and previous support leg swinging forward. Column2 and4 must lift opposite boots.
Do not duplicate the same lead-leg shape in columns1 and3. Empty left hand swings naturally in opposition to legs; silver katana remains securely in RIGHT hand in all poses. Keep the same young ADULT-STYLIZED body/face/canonical short brown haircut from reference2, dark red eyes and clean skin. Same black long coat, subtle burgundy lining, black pants/gloves/boots/silver belts and small normal physical accents. No transformation, hair growth, crystals, huge gauntlets/spikes, red blade or aura.
Crisp pixel-cluster raster matching approved source, slightly elevated RPG camera. Whole head/body/hands/boots/coat and whole katana tip together in every sprite with generous transparent space. Actual transparent RGBA, no ground/shadow/gradient/haze/checkerboard/grid/text/labels. Draw eight complete new figures; no anatomical assembly, body-part transplants, mirroring, flat rotation, distortion or blur.

ROW2 SOUTHWEST: clear front threequarter DOWN-LEFT at45degrees, nose/chest/hips/toes all down-left, physically distinct from front. ROW3 WEST: true LEFT PROFILE, nose and boots left, ONLY ONE visible eye; the near arm is anatomical LEFT and EMPTY, far RIGHT hand holds sword. Chain stays on anatomical LEFT waist in all views, never swapped by mirroring. Preserve vest/shirt emblem/buckles/chain asymmetries.
Same slightly elevated RPG camera and crisp deliberate pixel-cluster raster style as approved canonical identity. Each complete figure includes whole hair/head/body/both hands/feet AND ENTIRE katana blade tip with very generous transparent spacing. Actually transparent RGBA background; no floor, shadows, fog/gradient, checkerboard, text, labels, grid, frame, smoothing or blur. Independently draw complete figures; no mirroring, anatomical assembly, face transplant, flat rotation or warping.
